Abstract a top-down map into a few broad interlocking land parcels, one irregular turquoise lake, a simplified white glacier shape, and restrained blue-green landform blocks. Draw a thin ivory boundary precisely around the main lake with only 5 to 8 small circular editable-vertex markers and one subtle green prompt point. A few offset flat shapes can suggest image and annotation layers, but remain two-dimensional and clean. No photograph, no realistic landscape, no photographic texture, no aerial photo, no terrain relief shading, no 3D render, no isometric extrusions, no glossy bevels, no plastic, no grain, no decorative elevation contour lines, no dense grid, no glow or neon. Quiet lower third integrates into the navy field without a hard panel edge. Crisp, precise, serious desktop productivity brand, print-poster quality.
